name: SSVDAG Ray Traversal
aliases: Symmetry-aware Sparse Voxel DAG Traversal (SSVDAG Traversal)
definition: A shader-based raytracer implementation that traverses Symmetry-aware Sparse Voxel DAGs (SSVDAGs) for compression-domain tracing of high-resolution geometric scenes, supporting real-time rendering from GPU-resident data.
summary: SSVDAG Ray Traversal is a shader-based algorithm for efficiently rendering compressed voxel data by handling variable-size pointers and symmetry transformations during traversal.
